item.title: Binary Fan
item.description:
The binary fan platform lets you represent any binary Output Component as a fan.

# Example configuration entry
fan:
  - platform: binary
    output: fan_output
    name: "Living Room Fan"

Configuration variables

  • output (Required, ID): The id of the binary output component to use for this fan.

item.title: H-bridge Fan
item.description:
The hbridge fan platform allows you to use a compatible h-bridge (L298N, DRV8871, MX1508, BTS7960, L9110S, DRV8833, TB6612, etc.) to control a fan (or motor/solenoid).

# Example configuration entry
fan:
  - platform: hbridge
    id: my_fan
    name: "Living Room Fan"
    pin_a: motor_forward_pin
    pin_b: motor_reverse_pin
    # enable_pin: motor_enable
    decay_mode: slow   # slow decay mode (coasting) or fast decay (braking).

Configuration variables

  • pin_a (Required, ID): The id of the float output connected to Pin A (alternatively IN1, etc.) of the h-bridge.

item.title: Speed Fan
item.description:
The speed fan platform lets you represent any float Output Component as a fan that supports speed settings.

# Example configuration entry
fan:
  - platform: speed
    output: my_output_1
    name: "Living Room Fan"

Configuration variables

  • output (Required, ID): The id of the float output to use for this fan.

item.title: Template Fan
item.description:
The template fan platform lets you create a fan interface using only triggers.

# Example configuration entry
fan:
  - platform: template
    name: "Virtual Fan"
    on_state:
      - do something
    on_speed_set:
      - do something

Configuration variables

  • has_direction (Optional, boolean): Indicates if there should be a control for direction. Default is false.
  • has_oscillating (Optional, boolean): Indicates if there should be a control for oscillating. Default is false.
  • speed_count (Optional, int): Set the number of supported discrete speed levels. Default is only on/off.
  • preset_modes (Optional): A list of preset modes for this fan. Preset modes can be used in automations (i.e. on_preset_set ).
  • All other options from Fan Component.
